messages:
Kofi Opoku: hey team :wave: i’m Kofi — started today on Platform/Serving. excited to be here! quick question: i’m seeing the MDM enrollment email but not the laptop provisioning form. who should i ping for a replacement charger and a sticker pack?
Maria Chen: welcome Kofi!! :tada: i’m your onboarding buddy. i’ll DM you about chargers & stickers. there’s a 1pm new-hires lunch today in #lunch-plans if you can make it.
Kofi Opoku: awesome, thanks Maria. i’m remote (ET) so lunch would be virtual for me — happy to join. also, small thing: do i need to enroll my personal device or wait for the company laptop?
MDM Bot: Hi Kofi — please enroll any device you plan to use for work. Enroll here: https://mdm.example.com/enroll · If you need a company laptop, raise a ticket at https://helpdesk.example.com/tickets/new · Reply with "need-laptop" in this thread if you want us to pre-approve.
Kofi Opoku: noted, enrolling now. tagging @Sam Wells for VPN/ssh quickstart — i tried the `redwood-vpn` command but got a permission denied.
Sam Wells: hey Kofi — welcome! for VPN try:```bash
sudo /usr/local/bin/redwood-vpn login
```then run `redwood-ssh-setup` to add your SSH key to the roster. if permission denied persists, run `sudo chown $(whoami) /usr/local/bin/redwood-vpn` then retry. ping me if it still fails.
Jaxon Tran: adding one more FYI — our slack SSO occasionally needs one extra approval step in Okta for new hires. if you see a 403, open an Okta support request and tag me.
Rachel Lee: @Kofi welcome from People Ops! your onboarding calendar invites are being sent — 30-min 1:1 with your manager, and a benefits intro on Friday at 10am. swag box shipped to the address on file, DM me if shipping should go elsewhere.
Aria Gomez: hey Kofi — if you want a quick walkthrough of the Runtime codebase i can pair later today (ET afternoon). i’ll share a repo map and a short reading list.
Kofi Opoku: love that Aria, thanks. tiny fun fact: i once packed sushi bento for a 10-person hike. shout if you want bento recommendations :bento: . appreciate the warm welcome, team!
